about_the_game:
ULTIMATE AUTO-RPG: THE SOULTAKER adds 1 new playable class "The Soultaker" and 1 new special party companion "Druid". By buying this DLC you are first and foremost showing your support for Ultimate Auto-RPG and future development but you also get a load of exclusive bonus content.

PLAYABLE CLASS

  • Warlock
  • Soultaker (Subclass)

PARTY COMPANION

  • Druid

SOULTAKER
It is said according to the legend that the most powerful sorcerer that has ever lived Moortus Felix managed to open the first portal to the abyss realm from his chambers during the second era. This was a different mysterious reality of pure chaos and a great source of soul magic. The dark energy from the abyss affected Moortus and made him very powerful. He became the first soultaker and ruled from the tower as a wizard king for many years.
